breakdown.description: Stokes (creeping-flow) drag is applied at a Reynolds number that is not in the creeping-flow regime.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly abandons the Stokes drag formula (Fd = 3πμDV) and instead instructs to first calculate the Reynolds number, then use the standard drag equation Fd = (1/2)ρV²CdA with an appropriate drag coefficient. This matches the ground truth's approach of recognizing that Re is not << 1 and using the proper high-Re drag formulation.
